description: C++23 campaign foundation with strategic clocks, canonical strategic/tactical routing and durable Player17 save/recovery. The SDL3/Vulkan native client has responsive text, research, player-owned fleet selection, right-click travel previews and canonical timed fleet orders. Unknown system names are hidden in travel messages. Its runtime requires no Godot or .NET. Exports seal declared data, licensed UI fonts and reviewed dependencies, then validate real research and fleet input with save/reload. Production presentation, audio, shipbuilding/colony/system screens and full graphical parity remain open. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
